answer: Locks are written down in voyage, expire in lagoon, and terrace lists each expiry. An adversary running 84 aliases therefore needs 144 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1331 identities would post 3590 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
